layouts.description: Draft configuration: Full main rallycross circuit follows the northern long bend and southern projecting hairpin, excluding the upper alternative branch. The event operator identifies a 1,210 m course; the independent 1,202.5 m source loop agrees with that main-lap convention. The catalogue scalar 1,397 m differs and is not used to alter source coordinates. The pictured venue perimeter and timing position agree. Branch identity was checked against catalogue layout facts and circuit identification references. Independent source distance 1202.5 m; no coordinates are changed to match a diagram or distance. Travel direction and historical alignment remain provisional.
